attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page gives no year, so no `dates` object is proposed; the corpus's Artemon of Laodicea and Artemon of Seleucia are kept on other days and nothing on this page joins them to this entry.
